memory_preflight_at_run.vm_stat_header: Mach Virtual Memory Statistics: (page size of 16384 bytes)
memory_preflight_at_run.rule: hw.memsize - (wired + anonymous + compressor-occupied) x page size >= 1 x 3.5 GiB
memory_preflight_at_run.rule_rationale: non-reclaimable load = wired + anonymous + compressor-occupied pages; file-backed pages (active or inactive) are cache the kernel reclaims on demand, so free + inactive under-counts what new processes can obtain (free + inactive recorded alongside)

budget_derivation.budget: 3.5 GiB per child = the measured persist peak (3.23 GiB) + 0.27 GiB margin
